scope: Scientific plan only; not an implementation pre-run approval or evidence of completed fitting/native measurement

findings.evidence: Historical P is linear in the same phi and fixed U. The plan correctly calls linear residual fitting a prior-centered same-U refit. Phi is high-dimensional, so ordinary minimum-norm direct OLS and residual OLS need not agree off the training row space.
findings.resolution: Implementation identity control must test exact prior-centered ridge equivalence for rank-deficient designs. Any zero-penalty direct-OLS equality must state full-column-rank or historical-coefficient row-space conditions. This is a specification of the planned identity control, not a claim of new scientific expressivity.

findings.evidence: Residual candidate includes linear/RBF kernels, same-U direct control is linear, and full-D direct predictor independently tunes both linear/RBF with identical allowed features and new labels.
findings.resolution: This is adequate for the stated primary C versus P and secondary strong-direct comparison. A nonlinear residual win over same-U LINEAR alone would not isolate a benefit of residualization; report kernel selected and direct full-D comparison. No claim of a novel regression method.

findings.evidence: Three outer FIT groups preserve lexical blocks; inner training-only centering/kernel scale and tuning; frozen old P/U are disclosed priors; exposed64TEST not read for scores or selection; prospective fresh pairs after freeze.
findings.resolution: Approve conditional feasibility design. Outer CV is limited24-block evidence, not readout utility or independent model/task confirmation. Final all-FIT CV selection is separate from outer evaluation.

limitations: Documentary/methodological review of actual plan, decision, current roadmap/review policy, historical program assessment, latest A/B reports and completion receipts, plus A_L21 math/worker source. No native computation, fitting, cross-validation or new literature census.
